Title: Lucio Hotfix Patch
Subtitle: Hotfix 23.4.50673 (February 17, 2017), resolving an A.I. issue in Versus A.I. matches and a Lúcio talent/ability bug.
Highlights: Hotfix 23.4.50673 (February 17, 2017), resolving an A.I. issue in Versus A.I. matches and a Lúcio talent/ability bug.
CleanedNotes:
=== General ===
[Bug Fixes]
  • Fixed a rare issue that could cause A.I. players to stop functioning correctly during a Versus A.I. match.

=== Heroes: Lúcio ===
[Bug Fixes]
  • Learning Sonic Amplifier will no longer cause Amp It Up to benefit from Synaesthesia Auditiva.
